notes: New court pieces: ramps up to raised decks, jump pads (green ones throw you forward, cyan ones straight up and higher still if you land on them from a jump), moving walkways, floating platforms and elevators that carry you (and crush you against the floor or a wall), and spike pits. Knock someone into a pit and the kill is yours. The bomb rides, bounces and resets too.
A new court, Playground, with every new piece to try.
Jump pad guides: show where forward pads throw you, in Settings > Video (off by default).
Servers now send their court to everyone who joins, so new courts no longer need an update to play, and hosts will be able to share courts they make.
